goodToKnow: Tropisch means tropical: tropische Früchte, tropisches Klima. German meteorologists call a night that stays above 20 °C eine Tropennacht, and they are becoming more common with climate change. Die Tropen are the tropics, and Tropenholz tropical timber. Near Berlin, Tropical Islands, an indoor rainforest resort, was built in a huge former airship hangar. Tropenmedizin is tropical medicine.
